_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json
_meta.description: Tier 4-specialized: IFRS 16 Leases. Adds five new schemas (LeaseContract master register, LeasePaymentSchedule derived amortization rows, LeaseReassessmentEvent modification/remeasurement log, LeaseDisclosureTable period-end snapshot, LeasePortfolioExemption policy elections) per design.md D1–D5. RoU asset and lease-liability recognition, period interest/principal split and straight-line depreciation are computed by OCA\Shillinq\Service\LeaseAmortizationCalculator + LeasePaymentScheduleService + LeaseRecognitionService via the real OpenRegister ObjectService API (find/findAll/saveObject); disclosure aggregation by LeaseDisclosureService. LeaseContract carries an x-openregister-lifecycle state machine (draft→active→modified→terminated/expired); LeasePaymentSchedule and LeaseReassessmentEvent are read-only / immutable-once-posted. A contact/lessor counterparty is a Nextcloud-synced contact (ADR-022) referenced by FK, never a new person schema; source documents reference docudesk via FK URIs. Seed objects provide worked examples (vehicle lease, real-estate lease, short-term-exempt copier, derived schedule rows, a disclosure table and an exemption policy) per design.md.

LeaseDisclosureTable.title: IFRS 16 Disclosure Table
LeaseDisclosureTable.description: Period-end disclosure snapshot (design.md D5): RoU additions/depreciation/disposals and closing balance by asset class, current/non-current lease liability, maturity analysis buckets, weighted-average IBR per class, and the expense breakdown (interest, short-term, low-value, variable). Materialised at period close so prior-period restatements do not retroactively change a published disclosure.
